description: This Python module defines YAML constructors and factory functions for creating Bokeh visualization objects from YAML templates, including specialized constructors for documents and figures, and functions for creating mapping and sequence constructors used in YAML parsing.

methods.name: mapping_factory
methods.description: Creates a YAML constructor for a specific Bokeh widget or class, handling configuration and callbacks.

methods.name: sequence_factory
methods.description: Creates a YAML constructor for sequences of Bokeh objects, typically functions with positional arguments.

methods.name: document_constructor
methods.description: Constructs a Bokeh document from a YAML layout, adding elements to the current document.

methods.name: figure_constructor
methods.description: Constructs a Bokeh Figure object from YAML, including various glyphs and layout elements.
